newsitem.title: UK: UK Finsbury Asset Management sets biotech trust.
newsitem.headline: UK Finsbury Asset Management sets biotech trust.

text.p: Finsbury Asset Management said on Monday that it and Reabourne Limited and a unit of Merlin Ventures had launched a new life sciences and biotechnology investment trust.
Dubbed the Reabourne Merlin Life Sciences Investment Trust (RMLIT), it will be capitalised at up to 50 million stg and specialise in life science companies in Britain, Europe and Israel.
The trust will make investments in listed companies, as well providing financing to companies expected to seek a listing.

RMLIT also intends to invest 20 percent of its funds in The Merlin Fund LP, an early stage venture capital fund for biotechnology companies established in February by Chris Evans, the founder of Chiroscience Group and Celsis International.
Finsbury will manage the trust and will be advised by Merlin and Reabourne, a technology investment specialist.
